# Exact build tool versions for the release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml).
#
# Pinned so that building the same tag twice gives byte-identical files: the wheel records the
# hatchling version, and a `pypi` run checks its files against those a `testpypi` run uploaded.
# Do not change the pins between a `testpypi` and a `pypi` run of the same tag.
#
# Update with (and bump both uv `version:` pins in release.yml at the same time):
#   printf 'hatchling\nuv-dynamic-versioning\n' \
#     | uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.11 --no-header --no-annotate - \
#     > .github/build-constraints.txt.new
# and copy the pins below this header.
dunamai==1.26.5
hatchling==1.33.0
jinja2==3.1.6
markupsafe==3.0.4
packaging==26.4
pathspec==1.1.1
pluggy==1.7.0
tomlkit==0.15.3
trove-classifiers==2026.9.21.13
uv-dynamic-versioning==0.14.1
